sections.summary: AI Engineer with hands-on experience building Generative AI, LLM, RAG, multi-agent, and machine learning systems. Experienced in Python, LangChain, LangGraph, AI Agents, semantic search, vector retrieval, Computer Vision, and model evaluation, with full-stack development using React, Node.js, Express.js, and REST APIs. Built AI applications for recruitment automation, resume intelligence, and real-time workflow orchestration, with practical experience developing CNN-based computer vision solutions during a Machine Learning internship.

bullets: Engineered a CNN-based deep learning system for automated image selection and quality assessment.
Developed and evaluated image-quality assessment workflows to address real-world computer vision challenges.
Applied Python, deep learning, and model evaluation techniques to improve image-quality assessment workflows.

education.field: AI & Machine Learning; Full-Stack Development; Data Analytics & MLOps

projects.name: AgentFlow AI – Agentic AI Operations Automation Platform
projects.description: Designed and developed a scalable Agentic AI platform for intelligent workflow execution, validation, recovery, and real-time monitoring.
bullets: Engineered a Planner–Executor–Validator–Recovery multi-agent architecture with Redis/BullMQ queues, automated retries, and fault-tolerant workflow execution.
Implemented REST APIs and backend services for AI-agent execution, workflow orchestration, authentication, and real-time status tracking.
Developed a real-time workflow dashboard using React Flow and Socket.IO for execution monitoring and operator notifications.

projects.name: AI-Powered Resume Builder – Using SDD, LLM & RAG
projects.description: Designed and developed an AI-powered resume platform using LLMs, RAG, NLP, prompt engineering, and semantic search.
bullets: Engineered a LangGraph AI assistant with 5 specialized tools for resume updates, STAR bullet generation, ATS scoring, summary generation, and knowledge-base search.
Implemented semantic search and vector retrieval using Gemini embeddings and cosine similarity over a 68-document knowledge base.
Developed 6 specialized retrieval functions for ATS analysis, bullet generation, summary generation, resume review, job matching, and skill-gap analysis.

projects.name: Snap & Study — AI Vision Study Assistant
projects.description: Built a multimodal AI study assistant that analyzes question images, identifies the subject/topic, and generates step-by-step solutions.
bullets: Implemented interactive follow-up chat, context-aware explanations, study-note generation, and downloadable results.
Added specialized reasoning and verification workflows for mathematics and sentence-ordering/parajumble problems; deployed the application on Streamlit Community Cloud.

certifications.name: AI Workflows & Automation Workshop Using Make.com

publications.title: Multi-Agent Collaboration Systems Using Agentic AI for Intelligent Task Automation
publications.description: Studied multi-agent collaboration architectures for intelligent task automation, autonomous task decomposition, and agent communication. Analyzed planning, collaboration, memory, coordination, scalability, reliability, and security challenges in multi-agent AI systems. Proposed a scalable multi-agent architecture focused on LLM-driven agents, planning, collaboration, workflow orchestration, and decision-making.
